voice_and_source_limits: Qurtubi labels the phrase ما هذه البتيراء as occurring in a hadith but gives no narrator, collection, or chain in this row; this review makes no authenticity or isnad claim.

The poem is introduced as وأنشد without naming its poet in the stored Qurtubi row; do not supply an identity from a parallel lexicon.
